title.narrative: Initiative Africa 2018-2024, Making Change Happen 2 - Business for Peace
Initiative Africa 2018-2024, Making Change Happen 2 - Business for Peace

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för denna andra fas är att föra den privata sektorn till bordet och utveckla vägar för politisk dialog för att uppnå praktiska och fredliga lösningar på problem. Tanken är att företag ska hjälpa till att bevara sociala och medborgerliga strukturer genom att fortsätta göra affärer över olika konfliktgränser och arbeta tillsammans med andra civilsamhällesgrupper. Genom att arbeta med regeringen och olika delar av civilsamhällets organisationer på ett informerat och deltagande sätt, syftar projektet också till att förbättra utsikterna för jämställd och hållbar fred mellan könen.

The overall objective of this second phase is to bring the private sector to the table and develop avenues for political dialogue to achieve practical and peaceful solutions to problems. The idea is for business to help in preserving social and civic fabric by continuing to do business across different conflict lines and work together with other civil society groups. By working with the Government and the different segments of civil society organizations in an informed, participatory manner, the project also aims to improve the prospects for gender-equitable and sustainable peace.

Phase I implemented between 2018-2020 The project aims to bridge the gap between civics and peace building activities especially involving the private sector. It takes a two-pronged approach that includes: (a) development of several civic education programs as a tool for peace-building; and (b) enhancement of capacity of business to handle complex conflict subject matter, especially in relation to social inequality and justice. The following objectives are identified: 1. To mobilize the business community to engage in peace-building and conflict resolution actions and activities. 2. Through corporate social responsibility to maintain support for effective peace building and inclusive coordination amongst Government, private sector, media actors and civil society. 3. To respond to concrete challenges and opportunities to build a peaceful and just Ethiopia through civic education, training, internship and apprenticeship activities.
Phase II - Business for Peace, implementation period 2021-2023 This second phase aims to integrate and implement a peace building program to encourage Ethiopia's business community to positively influence the course of peace-making around the nation. The expanded objectives added to the approved MCH are: 1) To mobilize the business community to engage in peace building and conflict resolution actions and activities. 2) Through corporate social responsibility to maintain support for effective peace building and inclusive coordination amongst Government, private sector, media actors and civil society. 3) To respond to concrete challenges and opportunities to build a peaceful and just Ethiopia through civic education, training, internship, and apprenticeship activities.
